page_description

This tool enables users to inspect GWAS and functional genomics data for complex eye diseases. To start, select a phenotype and ancestry plus one of the following three options: Region, Target gene (eQTL), or Target gene (sQTL). All visualizations on this page will be rendered based on the user-specified input parameters. The Region and Target gene query boxes both accept the gene name as input. Try querying "TMCO1" to start. By default, GRCh38 coordinates are searched based on GENCODE gene annotations +/- 50 kb. The Region search also accepts custom GRCh38 coordinate ranges (chr:start-end).
